crossRefs.note: He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.
They went out and preached that people should repent.
They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.
They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed.…
while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant…

translations.web: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.
translations.bsb: So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.
translations.kjv: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
translations.asv: And they departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the gospel, and healing everywhere.
